title: Taking Off The Mask
author: William Saville
content:
It's hard to keep up the façade,
The mask that I wear each day,
Pretending to be someone else,
Hiding the parts that won't go away.

But what if I chose to be real,
To show the world who I can be,
To let the walls come tumbling down,
To be true to myself won’t be easy.

To let the pain and hurt show,
To let the tears fall down,
To admit that I'm not perfect,
And that sometimes I feel like I'll drown.

It's scary to be vulnerable,
To let others see inside,
But maybe that's what I need,
To heal and no longer hide.

For when we're brave enough to be real,
To take off our masks and show our true face,
We open ourselves to healing,
And find a way to a better place.

So I'll take a deep breath,
And let my true self shine,
I'll be open and honest,
And let the healing begin to climb.

I'll embrace the scars on my body,
And the pain in my heart and mind,
For they are a part of who I am,
And I won't leave them behind.

I'll be authentic and true,
And let my light shine bright,
For in being myself,
I'll finally find the way to take flight.
